recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended unless the work group reopens the later ElementDefinition.id and sliceName design.
issue_request: FHIR-6307 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked to document that sub-elements of named slices are expressed as a dot-separated list of ancestor elements beginning with the named slice name.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-6307. Jira says the clarification had already been handled in the profiling.html rewrite, and later history shows the relevant model was replaced by ElementDefinition.id plus sliceName token rules.
additional_context: FHIR-9843 added ElementDefinition.id as the reliable element reference and required the old name to be a token with no dot or space. FHIR-10068 directly reopened the FHIR-6307 dot-notation request and was Resolved - No Change because FHIR-9843 made it unnecessary. FHIR-12181 renamed ElementDefinition.name to ElementDefinition.sliceName, and FHIR-12182 documented the current id syntax as pathpart:slicename/reslicename.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing dot notation into sliceName would contradict later final decisions and current normative source; the current ElementDefinition.id algorithm already gives implementers the unambiguous profile-element identifier the seed requested.
